title: 郑和与“麒麟”
blurb_en: In 1415 an animal nobody had ever seen arrived in China. The whole court thought it was a unicorn.
blurb_zh: 一四一五年，一头谁都没见过的动物来到中国，大家都说它是神兽麒麟。
